basic_details.job_title: IIT Dharwad Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Infrastructure, Planning & Support (IPS) department of the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad is filling 2 Site Engineer (Electrical) posts on a 1-year contract, with consolidated emoluments of ₹ 42,000/- to 62,000/-. Applicants need a 3-year Diploma with 5 years' MEP experience, or a B.Tech/B.E. with 2 years' experience. Indian Nationals can apply only online at iitdh.ac.in until 4 December 2026, 23:59 Hrs.

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online process. The online application form and detailed instructions are on the Institute's staff recruitment page, https://www.iitdh.ac.in/staff-recruitment.

Pay the application fee of ₹ 200/- (including GST) through the State Bank e-pay facility. Its link is available in the online application. No other mode of payment is accepted, and payment in any other form stands forfeited.
Upload scanned copies of certificates, documents and mark sheets of all semesters/years, matriculation onwards, supporting qualification, experience, date of birth, caste, category and so on.
Submit the application by 4 December 2026, 23:59 Hrs. A hard copy of the online application form is not required to be sent.
After payment of the fee and submission, a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID.
For queries about submitting the online application, email [email protected]. Queries about eligibility or interpretation of rules are not entertained.
Scanned copies of certificates, documents and mark sheets of all semesters/years, matriculation onwards.

Experience certificate on the organization's letter head, with the date of issue, specific period of work, nature of duty, designation and pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the issuing authority.
Original certificates and self-attested copies, to be produced at the time of the selection process and while joining.
important_instructions: The selected applicant must make his/her own arrangements for housing outside the campus. Appointment is subject to the selected applicant being found medically fit as per the requirements of the Institute. Incomplete application forms, or forms without copies of all relevant certificates/documents, are liable to be summarily rejected. All details furnished in the online application are treated as final, and no changes are entertained. The applicant is responsible for the correctness of the entries. Selected applicants are expected to work six days a week and/or as decided by the Competent Authority. They may be assigned any duty within or outside the Institute, and may be assigned or transferred to any other position/office/department. The Institute verifies antecedents and documents at appointment or during service. Fake documents or suppressed antecedents lead to termination and possible legal action. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, is a disqualification for the post. Any corrigendum or addendum will be published only on the Institute's website. No interim correspondence is entertained about the conduct and result of tests or the reasons for not being called. Legal disputes may be challenged in the High Court of Dharwad.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad
content_sections.text: IIT Dharwad is an Institute of National Importance established by an Act of Parliament in 2016, at Chikkamalligawad, Dharwad, Karnataka. The notice says the Institute is looking for experienced staff who can contribute significantly to its construction and maintenance related work. This is a government institute recruitment, not a private job.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are invited to apply. Age, qualification and experience are counted as on the last date of application. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute. Applicants with an integrated M.Tech/M.E. degree are also eligible. For applicants with a Master's Degree in the respective discipline, the normal duration of the Master's programme is counted towards experience (maximum 2 years). Upper age limit: 50 years. The notice prints no age relaxation and no minimum age. The prescribed qualification and experience are a bare minimum; possessing them does not entitle an applicant to be called for a test and/or personal interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: 3 Year Diploma in relevant field with at least 50% of marks or equivalent CGPA grading, with 05 years of experience in mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) after diploma. OR B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent degree in relevant field with at least 50% of marks or equivalent CGPA grading, with 02 years' experience after degree.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries consolidated emoluments of ₹ 42,000/- to 62,000/-, commensurate with qualification and relevant experience. No other allowances in any form are admissible. Of the total consolidated monthly salary, 10% is variable and is paid as per performance. The contract period is 1 year, extendable based on the performance and the requirement. A yearly increment of 3% applies in case of extension, if any, based on performance. After the contract ends, the candidate has no right to further extension, regularization or permanency at the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Site Engineer [Electrical] [on contract]
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online process. The online application form and detailed instructions are on the Institute's staff recruitment page, https://www.iitdh.ac.in/staff-recruitment . Pay the application fee of ₹ 200/- (including GST) through the State Bank e-pay facility. Its link is available in the online application. No other mode of payment is accepted, and payment in any other form stands forfeited. Upload scanned copies of certificates, documents and mark sheets of all semesters/years, matriculation onwards, supporting qualification, experience, date of birth, caste, category and so on. Submit the application by 4 December 2026, 23:59 Hrs. A hard copy of the online application form is not required to be sent. After payment of the fee and submission, a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID. For queries about submitting the online application, email [email protected] . Queries about eligibility or interpretation of rules are not entertained. Scanned copies of certificates, documents and mark sheets of all semesters/years, matriculation onwards. Experience certificate on the organization's letter head, with the date of issue, specific period of work, nature of duty, designation and pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the issuing authority. Original certificates and self-attested copies, to be produced at the time of the selection process and while joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice gives the selection procedure as Test/Presentation/Interview/Any other mode as decided by the Institute (or) Selection Committee. It does not give dates or the venue of any stage. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of applicants called for test(s) and/or personal interview, on the basis of academic performance and/or qualification and/or experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Applicants should therefore give details of all qualifications and experience in the relevant field, over and above the minimum, with documentary evidence. Call letters and other information are sent by email, so the email ID in the application must be correct and active. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process.
